title: Nine Minutes of Opening
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：channel　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 channel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my mother was sent to open ① channel she could not trust, and she said the opening was the whole of the lesson. The ② channel, meaning the source and not the message, was nine minutes long and was opened by whoever came last; channel, she said, is the only thing on a screen that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ channel on that screen had the same voice, and the ④ channel at the end, meaning the one the editor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever opened properly. Channel, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ channel was the whole of the news, meaning the route it carried and not the source. The ⑥ channel, meaning the route and not any of that, is the only thing in the news that everybody follows and nobody questions; channel, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a source and a route. She said the route is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ channel had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the voice. The ⑧ channel of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine minutes and eleven years of opening; channel, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ channel I remember is the one at the end, which was opened in 1990 and is still described as the quietest in the county. A ⑩ channel, my grandmother said in 1995, is the only thing that improves by being opened; every channel, she said, is a route that has agreed to look like a source. She said the route was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 频道（指那个信源本身，与那条消息相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a channel 开通一个频道
D. n. 频道（指屏幕上每一个）
E. n. 频道（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 通道（抽象：它承载的那条路径）
G. n. 那条路径（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The channel, meaning the source and not the message
channel was the whole of the news
the channel had become a number in a report
The channel of the whole thing
A channel, my grandmother said in 1995

answers.why: open a channel 意为“开通一个频道”，1972 年母亲被派去开通她信不过的那个频道。
channel 意为“频道、渠道”，指那个信源本身而不是那条消息，长九分钟，由最后来的人开通。
channel 指屏幕上每一个频道，每一个都是同样的声音。
channel 指末尾那一个（编辑保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真开通过的。
channel 意为“通道”，抽象指它承载的那条路径，父亲说 channel 就是那条新闻的全部。
channel 为抽象用法，指那条路径本身，是新闻里人人都追、却没人质疑的东西。
channel 意为“频道、渠道”，到 1985 年这个 channel 成了报告里的一个数字。
channel 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九分钟和十一年的开通。
channel 意为“频道”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1990 年开通，至今仍被说成全县最安静的。
channel 为抽象总称，祖母说一个频道是唯一会因为被认真开通而变好的东西。

那个频道，指的是那个信源本身而不是那条消息，长九分钟，由最后来的人开通。（channel）
那块屏幕上每一个频道都是同样的声音。（channel）
末尾那个频道，指的是编辑保留的那一个，是唯一有人认真开通过的。（channel）
父亲说 channel 就是那条新闻的全部，指的是它承载的路径而不是那个信源。（channel）
1995 年祖母说，一个频道是唯一会因为被认真开通而变好的东西。（channel）
